name: Paul
note: The apostle, in prison, writing with joy.

name: Timothy
note: Named with Paul as sender; Paul hopes to send him to Philippi (2:19-24).

name: Epaphroditus
note: The Philippians' messenger, who nearly died and is being sent home with the letter (2:25-30; 4:18).

name: Euodia and Syntyche
note: Two women who worked with Paul and are now in disagreement; Paul urges them to agree (4:2-3).

name: Clement
note: A co-worker whose name is in the book of life (4:3).

name: The believers in Philippi
note: Paul's partners in the gospel, generous and a little divided.

name: Overseers and deacons
note: The leaders and helpers named in the greeting (1:1).

name: Jesus
note: Who humbled himself to the point of death on a cross, and whom God exalted.

name: The "dogs" and "evil workers"
note: Those who insisted on circumcision and put confidence in the flesh (3:2-3); Paul does not name them.

name: Caesar's household
note: The imperial slaves and freed people who served the emperor, who send greetings (4:22).
